text:
Emily Carter: Quick sync — marketplace go-live is next Wednesday 03:00 UTC. Need a fast check: press embargo, landing page, SI integration docs, and HW partner assets. Who's blocking?

Raj Patel: From the partner side — GCP legal flagged the wording on SLAs in the partner blurb. They want 'SLA-backed' changed to 'SLA-capable' until we have the contract. Can we swap before press?

Sophie Li: Noted. Marketing wants final press copy by EOD Monday. I'll update the draft but need the HW logos + size variants today. @Maya can you confirm logo delivery? :clock1:

Maya Rivera: On it — received logos from H-Accel, but their brand team requires a 48h approval window. I can request expedited approval (ask for png/svg and the legal badge). Might push into Monday.

Chris Nguyen: SI docs: the integration guide draft is in Confluence -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/x/XYZ123 (private). It's missing the troubleshooting section and the sample terraform snippet. I'll paste the snippet here so we can include in the landing "Integration" tab:
```
module "redwood_marketplace" {
  source = "github.com/redwood/integrations/aws"
  version = "v1.2.0"
}
```

Emily Carter: Good. Marketing also asked for 3 customer quotes for the landing hero. Do we have approvals to use quotes from Beta SI partners?

Raj Patel: We have internal permission for short quotes from StellarOps and CloudBridge, but legal requires a short attribution line. I'll ping them now.

Sophie Li: Press embargo: who is handling the embargo list? I have reporters flagged for cloud and infra beats, but want to confirm we coordinate with partner PRs.

Maya Rivera: Partner PR: H-Accel PR asked to see the embargo copy before distribution. They have a blackout until the public date. Suggest one combined embargo email to all partner PR contacts.

launch-bot: Reminder: staging -> prod migration window opens Tue 23:30 UTC. Runbook: runbook/redwood-marketplace-migration.md

Chris Nguyen: Migration note — make sure the feature flag for "marketplace_v2_userflow" is ON in prod after migration. Rolling canary for 30min.

Emily Carter: Action items summary: 1) Sophie to deliver press draft (Mon EOD). 2) Maya to chase H-Accel logo approval (ask for expedited). 3) Raj to get quote attributions and confirm SLA wording change with partner legal. 4) Chris to add troubleshooting + terraform snippet to SI docs and set feature flag runbook. 5) Ops to confirm migration window and canary.

Sophie Li: I'll post the press draft to #marketing-drafts and tag partners for review. If logos arrive later today I'll update the landing assets.

Raj Patel: Quick headset: do we need a joint blog or co-authored post with H-Accel? They offered to co-write a piece focusing on HW accelerators. If yes, timeline will be longer (2 weeks).

Maya Rivera: Co-auth blog sounds great but not for this immediate go-live. Recommend a follow-up co-marketing piece in Month+1. For launch, we should use a partner spotlight callout on the landing page.

Emily Carter: Agreed — spotlight callout for launch, co-authored longform later. Sophie — can you add a "partner spotlight" module to the landing wireframe?

Sophie Li: Yep. I'll add a modular block with logo, 2-sentence partner blurb, and CTA to partner integration guide.

Chris Nguyen: Small blocker: our telemetry tags for marketplace come from a new schema. Product analytics needs the event names by Monday noon. I'll paste mapping in the doc.

Emily Carter: Ok, assign analytics to Chris. Anyone else with blockers?

Maya Rivera: One more: H-Accel wants to review the landing attribution copy. I'll loop their brand lead into the draft PR review thread so they can approve faster.

Raj Patel: I'll follow up on the SLA wording and quote approvals. If anyone needs me to jump on a quick call with partner legal, ping.

Emily Carter: Thanks team — next sync Tue 16:00 UTC to confirm go/no-go checklist. If any critical changes happen, flag here or DM. :rocket:
